provenance.source: profiles built by scripts/gen-icc-oracles.py, each wrapped in a JP2 file (colr method 2) around one of the codestreams below
provenance.hash: SHA-256 of each output plane's samples in raster order, each a 4-byte big-endian signed integer
provenance.unconverted: opj_decompress failed or gave the samples as coded: LittleCMS refused the profile

rgb8.command: opj_compress -i in.raw -o rgb8_lossless.j2k -F 256,256,3,8,u -n 3 (in.raw: 256x256, R = x, G = y, B = (37x + 91y) mod 256, the first nine pixels black, white, R, G, B, C, M, Y and grey 128)

rgb16.command: opj_compress -i in.raw -o rgb16_lossless.j2k -F 64,64,3,16,u -n 3 (in.raw: 64x64, random.Random(187) samples, the first nine pixels the 8-bit corners times 257)

grey8.command: opj_compress -i in.raw -o grey8_lossless.j2k -F 64,64,1,8,u -n 3 (in.raw: 64x64, grey 0..255, then random.Random(188) samples)
